name: process_video
title: Process a video into short clips
description: Start clipping a video from its URL. OpenShorts downloads the source itself, transcribes it, finds the most viral moments with AI and renders vertical (9:16) clips. Captions and the AI hook line are burned by default; pass captions=false or auto_hook=false to skip either. Takes the URL as the user gave it; the video does not need to be opened or transcribed beforehand. Returns a job_id immediately — the work takes minutes; poll get_job_status or pass webhook_url to be called back. The caller must own the content or hold the rights to process it (confirm_rights).

source_url.description: Public video URL, passed through exactly as the user gave it (YouTube watch/short/live URL or a direct video file URL). The server does the downloading. Omit when using upload_id.

upload_id.description: Instead of source_url: the id from create_upload after the file was PUT to its upload_url. Use when the user gave you a video file rather than a link.

auto_hook.description: Burn the AI-written hook line (the clip's title) over the first seconds of each clip, as the dashboard does. Default true; set false for clean clips.

hook_style.description: Look of the hook text (with auto_hook). Default pill.

captions.description: Default true: burn word-level captions on every clip. Set false when the source already has subtitles burned in (they would stack) or the user wants clean clips; add_subtitles can still caption a clip later.

confirm_rights.description: Must be true: the user owns the content or has rights to process it.

layouts.description: Optional extra reframe layouts. 'auto' lets AI pick per video.

output_format.description: Canvas aspect ratio only. vertical is 9:16 but auto framing may retain a landscape picture with blurred padding. Use recut_clip vertical_layout=fill for a frame-filling portrait crop.

webhook_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL POSTed once when the job finishes or fails.

webhook_secret.description: Optional secret; the webhook body is then HMAC-SHA256 signed (X-OpenShorts-Signature).

force_low_quality.description: Set true to proceed after a needs_confirmation low-resolution warning.

target_clips.description: How many clips to aim for. A target, not a guarantee: fewer come back when the material doesn't hold them. Default: the AI decides (usually 2-6).

clip_max_seconds.description: Maximum clip length in seconds (default 60). Must be ≥ 5s above the minimum.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Operator supplied conservative cost estimate including model calls.

name: get_job_status
title: Get processing job status
description: Status of a processing job: 'queued', 'processing', 'completed' or 'failed', with recent log lines and, once completed, the clips.

name: list_clips
title: List a job's clips
description: List completed clips with titles, descriptions, source segments and download URLs.

name: get_quota
title: Get plan and remaining minutes
description: The authenticated user's plan and remaining processing minutes. Call before large jobs; process_video fails with quota_exceeded when the balance is insufficient.

name: add_subtitles
title: Burn styled captions onto a clip
description: Re-style the captions of one clip (clips already ship with the 'default' preset). Easiest: pass a preset; any other field you send overrides that part of it. Without a preset, style 'karaoke' highlights the active word.

preset.description: default: Anton caps, yellow active word. hormozi: words appear as spoken, yellow active word. pill: purple box behind the active word. lime: lime box behind the active word. oneword: one big word at a time. clean: no outline, soft shadow, sentence case.

font_size.description: 44 is the default (M); 34 = S, 56 = L, 70 = XL.

font_name.description: Anton, Montserrat ExtraBold, Verdana, Arial, Impact, Georgia...

highlight_color.description: Karaoke active-word color (or box color with effect 'highlight').

effect.description: Karaoke active-word effect; 'highlight' = solid box behind it.

reveal.description: Karaoke: words appear as they are spoken.

one_word.description: Show one word at a time.

border_width.description: Outline 0-10 (0 needs a shadow to stay readable).

estimated_cost_usd.description: Operator supplied conservative cost estimate including model calls.

name: recut_clip
title: Re-cut a clip from an edited segment list
description: Re-render one clip from a new list of source-video segments (the same engine behind the dashboard's clip editor). Times are seconds in the ORIGINAL source video: start from the clip's source_segments in list_clips (e.g. end 5 s earlier = lower the last end by 5). Segments are concatenated in the given order, so you can trim, extend, drop a dead moment in the middle, or reorder. Segments inside the clip's original range re-render in seconds; going outside needs the retained source video and re-runs the reframe engine.

segments.description: Ordered source segments the new clip is made of.

snap_to_words.description: Snap each boundary onto transcript word boundaries (recommended).

reapply_captions.description: Burn default captions back on after the recut (default true).

framing.description: Layout override: 'full' shows the whole source frame (no side-cropping), 'track' forces the subject-tracking crop, 'auto' resets to the AI classifier. Omit to keep the clip's current framing. Non-auto values re-run the reframe engine and need the retained source video.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Operator supplied conservative cost estimate including model calls.

vertical_layout.description: Portrait picture layout: fill crops and tracks the subject to fill 9:16; fit preserves the whole landscape picture with blurred bands; auto lets OpenShorts decide. Do not combine with framing. Requires retained source video.
